title: Fogmog
move_pattern: Starts with Illusory Spores (summons an ally). Then Thwack. Afterwards cycles: 40% chance (Thwack → Headbutt) or 60% chance (Headbutt) → back to Thwack.
notes: Fogmog's opening move summons an EyeWithTeeth ally to aid it in combat. After the first Thwack, Fogmog alternates between attacking and choosing randomly between a paired Thwack+Headbutt or just Headbutt. The Headbutt move is not displayed in the bestiary but is executed as part of the attack pattern.
